raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Increase KV cache capacity for GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 on Ascend 910B4 by avoiding indexer cache allocation for DSA layers that reuse the previous layer’s top-k indices, while preserving model accuracy.

## Modifications

- Allocate indexer cache slots only for layers that compute top-k indices.
- Align NPU memory-budget sizing with the compact indexer allocation so the saved memory can be used for additional KV cache tokens.

## Accuracy Tests

The AIME26 mean accuracy remained unchanged before and after the change at **0.9333** (30 examples).

| Model | Dataset | Metric | Subset | Num | Score | Category |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 | aime26 | mean_acc | default | 30 | 0.9333 | default |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

| Metric | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| #tokens | 55.5K tokens | 63.5K tokens |

Measured on Ascend 910B4. KV cache capacity increased by **8K tokens** (approximately **14.4%**).

## Checklist

- [x] Format and lint checks completed.
- [x] Relevant unit tests: 55 passed; 2 deselected because the environment lacks the `openai` dependency.
- [x] Accuracy and KV cache capacity results included.

+"""CPU regressions for NPU DSA indexer pool layer ownership."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache import kv_cache_configurator as kcc
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, stage="base-a", runner_config="cpu")
+
+
+class TestNPUIndexerLayerLayout(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_non_arch35_dsa_pool_uses_only_active_indexer_layers(self):
+        """Shared layers must not consume indexer slots on non-arch35 NPU."""
+        configurator = kcc.KVCacheConfigurator.__new__(kcc.KVCacheConfigurator)
+        configurator.device = "cpu"
+        configurator.is_draft_worker = False
+        configurator.kv_cache_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+        configurator.layer_info = SimpleNamespace(
+            start_layer=10,
+            end_layer=14,
+            num_effective_layers=4,
+        )
+        configurator.model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+            hf_config=object(),
+            kv_lora_rank=16,
+            qk_rope_head_dim=8,
+            index_head_dim=32,
+        )
+        pool = object()
+
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                kcc,
+                "get_parallel",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(attn_dcp_size=2),
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                kcc,
+                "get_schedule",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(page_size=16),
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                kcc,
+                "get_exec",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(
+                    features=SimpleNamespace(enable_memory_saver=False)
+                ),
+            ),
+            patch.object(kcc, "_should_elide_dsa_index_k", return_value=True),
+            patch.object(
+                kcc,
+                "dsa_layer_skips_topk",
+                side_effect=lambda _config, layer_id: layer_id in (11, 13),
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.utils.is_npu_arch35",
+                return_value=False,
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.memory_pool_npu.NPUMLATokenToKVPool",
+                return_value=pool,
+            ) as pool_class,
+        ):
+            result = configurator._build_ascend_mla_kv_pool(
+                max_total_num_tokens=64,
+                is_dsa_model=True,
+            )
+
+        self.assertIs(result, pool)
+        self.assertEqual(pool_class.call_args.args, (64,))
+        self.assertEqual(pool_class.call_args.kwargs["index_size"], 128)
+        self.assertEqual(pool_class.call_args.kwargs["indexer_layer_ids"], (10, 12))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import unittest
+
+    unittest.main()

+            "full",
+            "shared",
+            "full",
+            "shared",
+            "shared",
+            "shared",
+        ]
+        available_bytes = 1_000_000
+

+

+        dense_cell_size = (576 + 128) * num_layers * 2
+        self.assertEqual(configurator._cell_size, compact_cell_size)
+        self.assertGreater(
